changes: Ported from JavaScript to C# on 2026-11-06, with the same physics, numbers and defaults. C# configs have no colored or aligned headers and no slider suffixes. The JavaScript wrapped most game calls in a catch that ignored failures, which the bridge needed: here only the texture reads keep it, so any other failure now goes to the log and the error panel instead of being silent. Corpses are kept in a Dictionary instead of an insertion-ordered Map, so when a ragdoll overlaps several others the one pushing it first may differ.
